title: LEGOSpec: A Composable and Efficient Framework for Speculative Draft Design and Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.33004v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) generation using a lightweight draft. Existing methods evaluate complete recipes under different training configurations, leaving component effects, interactions, and composition benefits unclear. Therefore, we present LEGOSpec, a composable framework for speculative draft design and training. LEGOSpec decomposes draft models into Context, Backbone, Proposal, and Objective components that share a unified training infrastructure. Using LEGOSpec, we systematically vary components and evaluate selected combinations under matched training conditions to isolate their effects and interactions. These experiments reveal three findings: (1) Different workloads favor different backbones, depending on context length and memory budget, with within-block dependency modeling particularly important for long contexts. translated_title: LEGOSpec：一个用于推测性草稿设计与训练的可组合高效框架
translated_abstract: 推测性解码使用轻量级草稿模型来加速大语言模型（LLM）的生成。现有方法在不同的训练配置下评估完整的方案，导致各组件的效果、相互作用以及组合收益不明确。因此，我们提出了LEGOSpec，一个用于推测性草稿设计与训练的可组合框架。LEGOSpec将草稿模型分解为上下文、骨干、提议和目标四个组件，它们共享统一的训练基础设施。借助LEGOSpec，我们系统地改变各个组件，并在匹配的训练条件下评估选定的组合，以隔离它们各自的效果与相互作用。这些实验揭示了三个发现：（1）不同的工作负载偏好不同的骨干网络，这取决于上下文长度和内存预算，其中块内依赖建模对长上下文尤为重要。（2）提议设计必须在接受率与延迟之间取得平衡。（3）训练目标……（摘要截断）
tldr: LEGOSpec提出了一个可组合的推测性草稿设计与训练框架，将草稿模型分解为上下文、骨干、提议和目标四个组件，并通过系统化的对照实验揭示了不同工作负载下各组件的作用、相互作用及最优组合规律。
en_tdlr: LEGOSpec presents a composable framework for speculative draft design and training that decomposes draft models into Context, Backbone, Proposal, and Objective components, systematically isolating their effects and interactions across different workloads through controlled experiments.
